title: Court judgments in the corpus
goal: Judgments of the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court decided from 2021 on, all the way into search: fetch, OCR, chunk, links to the sections they cite, publish to kb, embed. The backlog comes in bulk where it already exists (Supreme Court: the Wayback Machine's archive of the court's own listing and PDFs, the GitHub mirror for PDFs Wayback lacks); the live sites are crawled for what bulk lacks and then nightly, only for new items (published PDFs never change: user, 2026-11-15). The Supreme Court site is reached through its Cloudflare challenge with a real browser session (user, 2026-11-15). The app citing judgments is the next brief.
for_whom: Sri Lankan lawyers, who argue from judgments as much as from sections (docs/APP.md); the release waits for judgments.

done_check.check: Supreme Court backlog: every row decided 2021-01-01 to 2026-08-07 in Wayback's 2026-08-20 capture of supremecourt.lk/judgements/ (1,491 rows) is listed with date, case number, parties, judge, keywords and the Legislation column; its PDF comes from the nuuuwan mirror (1,348 on 2026-11-16), else Wayback, else the live site, else the row records that no copy was found.

A Court of Appeal spider (courtofappeal.lk/judgments?year=YYYY) lists 2021-2026 in one pass (3,194 rows on 2026-11-16), then nightly only the current year (and the previous one in January). Rows per year match the year page's row count; each row keeps decided date, case number, parties, judge, keywords and the Legislation column.

A Supreme Court spider gets through the Cloudflare challenge on ampere (a real browser session, a few seconds between requests), lists what was decided after 2026-08-07 and fetches the PDFs bulk lacked, then nightly only new rows. A night it cannot pass the challenge adds 0 rows, logs a warning and the rest of the run goes on (user, 2026-11-16). docs/SOURCES.md records how.
Two sample years (one CA, one SC) go through fetch, extract/OCR and build. The user gets the scan share, GPU hours, chunk count and an estimate for the rest, and the rest runs only after their go.

All listed judgments from 2021 on are published to kb and embedded in Zilliz (production writes ask first); the quality gate passes; every chunk has its page; each judgment links to the sections it cites (from the Legislation column and the text); 10 judgments read by hand match their PDFs.
Search finds judgments: for 10 questions written from a judgment's subject (not its case number), that judgment is in the top 10 for at least 8.
docs/PIPELINE_V2.md (judgment types, keys, the court spiders, the bulk sources, measurements), docs/SOURCES.md (both courts) and the keys line in CLAUDE.md are updated.

scenarios.steps: The Court of Appeal posts a new judgment; the nightly run follows.
scenarios.expect: The next morning it is listed, fetched, chunked and searchable, and no earlier year page was walked.

scenarios.steps: Take CA/WRT/0634/2023 (Industrial Disputes Act ss. 4(1), 17(1), 19; Constitution Article 140): read its chunks in kb and its links.
scenarios.expect: Parties, date and judge are right; the text reads like the PDF with page numbers; it links to Industrial Disputes Act s.4(1), s.17(1), s.19 and Article 140.

scenarios.steps: A nightly run on a day neither court published anything.
scenarios.expect: The court spiders add 0 rows and fetch nothing; only the current year's page of each was read.

scenarios.steps: Take SC/APPEAL/133/2018, decided 07 Aug 2026 (the newest row in Wayback's listing).
scenarios.expect: Listed with its date, parties and judge from the court's listing; its text and chunks are in kb and it is searchable.

scenarios.steps: A night the Supreme Court site's challenge does not pass.
scenarios.expect: The SC step adds 0 rows with a warning in Dagster; the Court of Appeal and the rest of the run complete; the next night picks up what was missed.

out_of_scope: Judgments decided before 2021 (user, 2026-11-16), law reports (NLR, SLR); other courts (High Court, Magistrate's Courts).
Making the existing spiders (documents.gov.lk, parliament.lk, lankalaw) list only new items: later (user, 2026-11-15).
The app citing judgments (next brief, on an app branch).
A full re-walk of the court sites, on a schedule or on demand.
